title: Best AI website builder deal: Get Hostinger for just $2.69 per month
excerpt: Your dream website is one AI prompt away.
content_html:
TL;DR: As of July 25, Hostinger's Website Builder starts at $2.69 per month (down from $11.99 per month), with plans available directly on Hostinger. You can build a full site by chatting with AI, plus get a free domain for the first year.

Credit: Hostinger

$2.69 per month (down from $11.99 per month)

Building a website used to mean either paying someone else to do it or losing a weekend fighting with a clunky drag-and-drop editor that never quite matched what you had in your head. Hostinger has an easier approach: you just describe your site to their AI, and it builds a live, professional-looking site in seconds.

This weekend, you can get up to 82% off Hostinger, with prices starting at $2.69 per month.

There are two plans to pick from, and which one is right for you depends on what you're building. The Premium Website Builder is the more basic option at $2.69 per month (regularly $11.99 per month), letting you build up to three websites with 20GB of storage and a free domain for the first year. Here's what you get:

  • Drag-and-drop website builder

  • 300+ designer-made templates

  • AI tools to write your copy and design your logo

  • Free domain for 1 year

  • Email campaigns with AI

  • Mobile editing

That's solid if you're building something like a portfolio, a blog, or a simple business site. It's worth noting that you save the most with the 48-month plan, totaling $446.35. The 12-month plan saves less, at $100.79.

If you're planning to sell products, the Business Website Builder is the one for you. It's $3.41 per month (down from $18.99 per month), and on top of everything in Premium, you get the following:

  • Sell up to 1,000 products with zero transaction fees

  • Support for 100+ payment methods

  • Live analytics

  • Printful integration for custom merch

  • AI blog post generator

  • AI SEO assistant

  • AI tools that write product descriptions for you

Just like with Premium, the 48-month plan saves you the most, with total savings of $747.79. The 12-month plan saves less, at $173.99.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

This deal is worth considering if you're a new business owner who's been hesitant to explore website building. Between the discount and the 30-day money-back guarantee, it's a low-risk way to try it out — both plans include real hosting, a free domain, and 24/7 support.

Stop putting it off — build your dream site with Hostinger, with plans starting as low as $2.69 per month.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR：自 7 月 25 日起，Hostinger 的网站构建器起价为每月 2.69 美元（原为每月 11.99 美元），可直接在 Hostinger 上购买套餐。 您可以通过与 AI 聊天来构建完整的网站，并获得第一年的免费域名。

信用：Hostinger

每月 2.69 美元（原为每月 11.99 美元）

过去，建立一个网站意味着要么花钱请别人来做，要么在一个周末与一个笨重的拖放编辑器战斗，而这个编辑器永远不符合你的想法。 Hostinger 有一种更简单的方法：您只需向他们的人工智能描述您的网站，它就会在几秒钟内构建一个实时的、具有专业外观的网站。

这个周末，您可以享受 Hostinger 高达 82% 的折扣，起价为每月 2.69 美元。

有两种计划可供选择，哪一种适合您取决于您​​要构建的内容。 高级网站构建器是更基本的选项，价格为每月 2.69 美元（通常为每月 11.99 美元），允许您在第一年建立最多三个具有 20GB 存储空间和免费域名的网站。 这是你得到的：

  • 拖放式网站构建器
  • 300+ 设计师制作的模板
  • 用于撰写文案和设计徽标的人工智能工具
  • 1年免费域名
  • 人工智能电子邮件营销活动
  • 移动编辑

如果您正在构建投资组合、博客或简单的商业网站之类的内容，那么这很可靠。 值得注意的是，48 个月的计划为您节省了最多的费用，总计 446.35 美元。 12 个月计划节省的费用较少，为 100.79 美元。

如果您打算销售产品，那么商业网站构建器就是您的最佳选择。 每月费用为 3.41 美元（原为每月 18.99 美元），除了 Premium 的所有内容外，您还可以获得以下内容：

  • 以零交易费用销售多达 1,000 种产品
  • 支持100多种支付方式
  • 实时分析
  • 定制商品的打印集成
  • AI博客文章生成器
  • 人工智能SEO助手
  • 为您编写产品描述的人工智能工具

与 Premium 一样，48 个月计划为您节省最多，总共节省 747.79 美元。 12 个月计划节省的费用较少，为 173.99 美元。

混搭优惠

注册即表示您同意按照提供的号码接收来自 Mashable Deals 的定期自动 SMS 营销消息。 消息和数据速率可能适用。 每天最多 2 条消息。 回复 STOP 可选择退出，回复 HELP 寻求帮助。 同意不是购买的条件。 请参阅我们的隐私政策和使用条款。

如果您是一位新企业主，并且一直对探索网站建设犹豫不决，那么这笔交易值得考虑。 在折扣和 30 天退款保证之间，这是一种低风险的尝试方式 - 两种计划都包括真实托管、免费域名和 24/7 支持。

不要再拖延了——使用 Hostinger 构建您的梦想网站，套餐起价为每月 2.69 美元。
